Senses.Explanation: One arrow past Silla pictures an answer traveling so far and fast that deliberation is already late. Chan masters give it as a direct reply to same-or-different questions; when the questioner hesitates, the record says the sword or arrow has long since gone. Yuanjie Ying answers “what is the mechanism apart from position?” with the arrow line. Tongtian gives it to the question whether ancestral and scriptural meaning are same or different, then says the sword has long gone. Changlu Yingfu gives the same answer to a question about tathagata Chan and ancestral Chan, then shouts when his questioner hesitates.
